commands.name: elevation download
commands.summary: Download NMT, NMPT, LAZ or contours as sheets, tiles or one WCS cutout
commands.description: Fetches the DTM (NMT), DSM (NMPT), LAZ point clouds or CZ contours of GUGiK (PL) and CUZK (CZ) into the versioned store; `cutout` gives one WCS raster instead of sheets. Never overwrites: new content is a new version. `output_dir` writes plain files, not the store. Not for imagery (`imagery download`).

options.name: product

enum.meaning: Digital terrain model (bare earth); PL and CZ.
Digital surface model (with the objects on the ground); PL and CZ.
LIDAR point cloud; PL and CZ.
ZABAGED contours, 2D vector, SM5 sheets, SHP or DGN; CZ.

options.description: Product.

pl.description: Produkt (wymagany).

enum.nmt: Numeryczny Model Terenu; PL i CZ.
enum.nmpt: Numeryczny Model Pokrycia Terenu; PL i CZ.
enum.laz: Chmura punktow LIDAR; PL i CZ.
enum.contours: Warstwice ZABAGED: wektor 2D, arkusze SM5, SHP albo DGN; CZ.

options.name: country

enum.meaning: Both: the area is split by the bounding boxes of PL and CZ, one file per country.

options.description: Country of the source; required with `bbox` or `geometry`, implied by a sheet code (a given value must agree). `auto` splits the area between PL and CZ.

options.name: sheet
options.description: Sheet code: PL-1992 (`N-34-130-D-d-2-4`), PL-2000 (`6.129.30.25.3`), CZ SM5 (`CTES96`) or CZ TM33 (`302_5550`). A coarser PL code expands to the source sheets; contours take SM5 sheets only. Give exactly one of `sheet`, `bbox`, `geometry`.

options.name: bbox
options.description: Area rectangle [min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y] in the CRS of bbox_crs, as numbers (metres, or degrees for EPSG:4326). Give exactly one of `sheet`, `bbox`, `geometry`.

pl.description: Prostokat obszaru: min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y w ukladzie `bbox_crs`.

options.name: bbox_crs
options.description: CRS of bbox, required with it (the CLI defaults to EPSG:2180).

pl.description: Uklad wspolrzednych `bbox` (domyslnie EPSG:2180).

options.name: geometry
options.description: Vector file (SHP, GPKG or GeoJSON): PL sheets that intersect its features (a polygon, not its extent); LAZ tiles, CZ LAZ and contours: those that intersect its extent; cutout: its extent. Give exactly one of `sheet`, `bbox`, `geometry`.

options.name: layer
options.description: GPKG layer of geometry (default: the first one).

options.name: resolution
options.description: Grid resolution label such as `1m`; required where the product offers a choice. One value applies to every country of the task, or give {"pl": "1m", "cz": "2m"}. Choices per source: `elevation list-sources`. Not used for LAZ and contours.

options.name: model

enum.meaning: Terrain model on a 5 m grid (DMR 4G).
Surface model from image correlation (DMP OK).

options.description: CZ LAZ point-cloud model; required with `product=laz` when the task reaches CZ. Not for other products.

options.name: vertical_crs

enum.meaning: European Vertical Reference Frame 2007: the current PL height system (PL-EVRF2007-NH) and the native one of CZ TM33 files.
Kronstadt 86: the historical PL height system (PL-KRON86-NH).
Baltic after adjustment: native for CZ S-JTSK, SM5 and ImageServer data.

options.description: Height system; required (omit for NMT 100 m: GUGiK declares none). One value must exist in every country of the task, or give {"pl": "EVRF2007", "cz": "Bpv"}. CZ LAZ: Bpv is SM5 files, EVRF2007 TM33 files (clouds are not transformed); CZ contours: Bpv, may be omitted.

pl.description: Uklad wysokosci (wymagany). PL: EVRF2007 (uklad obowiazujacy), KRON86 (uklad historyczny).

options.name: format

enum.meaning: ASCII NMT points X Y Z, ZIP.
ASCII TBD structure points and lines, ZIP.

options.description: File format. Without it NMT/NMPT PL are ASC grids. Source archives (XYZ, TIN, ...) are fetched as published, without conversion, and not with `cutout`; contours (required): SHP or DGN, the ZIP of an SM5 sheet. Variants: `elevation list-sources`.

options.name: sheet_system
options.description: Sheet system of PL sheets: `1992` (1:10000 sheets) or `2000` (zones EPSG:2176-2179, needs `scale`). Required with `bbox` or `geometry` for PL (not with `cutout` or LAZ); implied by a sheet code.

options.name: scale

enum.meaning: Sheets or maps at the scale 1:5000.
Sheets or maps at the scale 1:2000.
Sheets or maps at the scale 1:1000.
Sheets or maps at the scale 1:500.

options.description: Scale of PL-2000 sheets: required with `bbox` or `geometry` and `sheet_system=2000`, and with a PL-2000 1:10000 code; optional with a finer code (expands it to its descendants). Not for PL-1992 (always 1:10000), CZ, LAZ and `cutout`.

options.name: cutout
options.description: Fetch one WCS cutout instead of sheets (with `bbox` or `geometry`; needs `horizontal_crs`). PL: 1 m NMT/NMPT on the sheet grid, masked to the PL land, as the server composes its flights (for the newest flight fetch sheets). CZ: an exportImage cutout, required for CZ raster areas. Not for LAZ.

pl.description: Tryb JEDNEGO wycinka zamiast arkuszy (tylko `bbox` albo `geometry`; wymaga `horizontal_crs`).

options.name: horizontal_crs
options.description: CRS of the cutout; required with `cutout`, refused without it. Reprojected locally; the CZ native CRS is EPSG:5514.

pl.description: Uklad poziomy wycinka: wymagany z `cutout`.

options.name: year
options.description: Only this data year (acquisition year; `akt_rok` for LAZ): the newest flight of that year. A sheet or tile without it stops the run before any download. Excludes `min_year` and `max_year`; not with `cutout`.
options.section: Data year, flights and tiles (PL only)

pl.section: Rok danych, loty i kafle (tylko PL)
pl.description: Tylko ten rok danych; nie dziala z `cutout`.

options.name: min_year
options.description: Lower bound of the data year (inclusive): the newest flight in the range, or all of them with `all_campaigns`. Not with `cutout`.
options.section: Data year, flights and tiles (PL only)

pl.section: Rok danych, loty i kafle (tylko PL)

options.name: max_year
options.description: Upper bound of the data year (inclusive): the newest flight in the range, or all of them with `all_campaigns`; the standard path never moves to an older flight. Not with `cutout`.
options.section: Data year, flights and tiles (PL only)

pl.section: Rok danych, loty i kafle (tylko PL)

options.name: all_campaigns
options.description: Fetch every flight of the year range into `versions/` instead of the newest one per sheet. LAZ: coverage is not deduplicated. Not with `cutout`.
options.section: Data year, flights and tiles (PL only)

pl.section: Rok danych, loty i kafle (tylko PL)

options.name: full_sheet
options.description: NMT/NMPT: when the newest flight of a sheet is not full (`calyArkuszWypelnionyTrescia`), also fetch the newest full flight of the range (one more per sheet at most) and link it under `full_sheet/`. Not with `cutout` and LAZ.
options.section: Data year, flights and tiles (PL only)

pl.section: Rok danych, loty i kafle (tylko PL)

options.name: min_density
options.description: LAZ PL only: keep the tiles with at least this point density (points per m2).
options.section: Data year, flights and tiles (PL only)

pl.section: Rok danych, loty i kafle (tylko PL)

options.name: output_dir
options.description: Directory for plain files named as in the store (no sidecar, no versions). A repeated name, a store or an existing file (without `update` force) is a `conflict` and nothing is written. Store only: `update` upgrade and `plan`. PL sheets: the newest FULL flight, not the newest one; a sheet with none is skipped (warning `skipped_incomplete`), all skipped is `no_data`. Give at most one of `output_dir`, `root`.

pl.description: Katalog na zwykle pliki (nazwy jak w magazynie, bez sidecara i wersji).

options.name: root
options.description: Store root: versions are written below it, one directory per product, never over existing ones. Default: the store of the user data directory (`KARTOGRAF_ROOT`, `[kartograf] root` of `nogat.toml`, else `<data_dir>/kartograf`). Give at most one of `output_dir`, `root`.

pl.description: Katalog magazynu (domyslnie magazyn uzytkownika).

options.name: check
options.description: Plan without effects: compare the local versions with the source and return the plan (kartograf-plan/1: current, newer, to download, or cannot be checked without downloading); nothing is fetched or written. With `output_dir`: write, replace or conflict per target. Cheap signal: the ETag of SM5 sheets, TM33 DMR 4G and DMP OK EVRF2007 tiles and CZ LAZ; cutouts and ImageServer tiles have none.

options.name: update

enum.meaning: Fetch newer content when the source signals it.
Fetch every file again; nothing is overwritten.

options.description: Update mode. Omitted: keep the local versions and fetch the missing ones. upgrade: fetch newer content when the source signals it (store only). force: fetch every file again (store: the same content is unchanged, other content is a new version; `output_dir`: it replaces the files). CLI: --upgrade, --force.

options.name: plan
options.description: Update plan (the result of a check) to run with update=upgrade; a position that changed since the plan stops the run. Store only. CLI: the file of --plan.

options.name: workers
options.description: Parallel transfers (default 4; 1 = one by one).

rules: Run `elevation availability` first if you do not know which years, grids and CRSs exist.
Set `vertical_crs` and `resolution` yourself: nothing is guessed.

examples.call: kartograf elevation download --product nmt --sheet N-34-130-D-d-2-4 --resolution 1m --vertical-crs EVRF2007 --root ./data
examples.title: PL sheet: NMT 1 m in EVRF2007

examples.call: kartograf elevation download --product laz --country pl --bbox 530000,382000,533000,386000 --vertical-crs KRON86 --root ./data
examples.title: PL LAZ point cloud for a rectangle

examples.call: kartograf elevation download --product nmt --country pl --bbox 565000,242000,565500,242500 --resolution 5m --vertical-crs EVRF2007 --sheet-system 1992 --root ./data
examples.title: PL area: NMT 5 m sheets in the 1992 system

examples.call: kartograf elevation download --product nmt --country pl --bbox 566000,243000,566500,243500 --vertical-crs EVRF2007 --cutout --horizontal-crs EPSG:2180 --root ./data
examples.title: PL cutout: NMT 1 m from WCS

examples.call: kartograf elevation download --product nmt --sheet CTES96 --resolution 5m --vertical-crs Bpv --root ./data
examples.title: CZ SM5 sheet: NMT 5 m in Bpv

examples.call: kartograf elevation download --product nmt --country cz --bbox -447000,-1114000,-446000,-1113000 --bbox-crs EPSG:5514 --resolution 5m --vertical-crs Bpv --cutout --horizontal-crs EPSG:5514 --root ./data
examples.title: CZ cutout in S-JTSK

examples.call: kartograf elevation download --product laz --country cz --bbox -447000,-1114000,-446000,-1113000 --bbox-crs EPSG:5514 --model dmr5g --vertical-crs Bpv --root ./data
examples.title: CZ LAZ point cloud: DMR 5G model for a rectangle

pl.summary: Pobierz NMT, NMPT, LAZ albo warstwice (arkusze, kafle albo wycinek)
pl.description: Pobierz NMT, NMPT i chmury punktow LAZ z GUGiK (PL) albo CUZK (CZ) do magazynu wersji. PL: --bbox/--geometry wybiera arkusze/kafle LAZ, --cutout --horizontal-crs daje wycinek 1 m z WCS GUGiK; NMT 100 m (--resolution 100m) to pliki XYZ wojewodztw obszaru. CZ: rastry SM5/TM33 z plikow CUZK albo ImageServer (kafle TM33 DMR 4G i DMP OK z plikow ETRS89/EVRF2007); dla obszaru rastra --cutout wymagane. LAZ CZ: --model i arkusz SM5/TM33 albo obszar (arkusze z indeksu), bez --cutout i bez transformacji chmur. Warstwice CZ (--product contours --format SHP|DGN): ZIP arkusza SM5 1:1, obszar = arkusze SM5 z indeksu, bez --cutout. --output-dir zapisuje zwykle pliki, nie magazyn.
rules: Najpierw `elevation availability`, gdy nie wiesz, jakie lata, siatki i uklady sa dostepne.
Podaj `vertical_crs` i `resolution` jawnie: nic nie jest zgadywane.

commands.name: cn weighted
commands.summary: Compute the area-weighted CN of a watershed made of several parts.
commands.description: Area-weighted CN of a watershed from parts with a known CN and area or share: `parts`, or parallel `cn_values` with `areas` or `fractions` (shares sum to 1). Use after `cn lookup` for each part; the result is fractional and fits `scs effective`.

options.name: parts
options.description: Watershed parts as objects `{"cn": number 1-100, "area": area >= 0}` or `{"cn": ..., "fraction": share 0-1}`; all parts of one list use the same kind of weight (`area` or `fraction`).

pl.description: Części zlewni jako obiekty `{"cn": liczba 1–100, "area": powierzchnia ≥ 0}` albo `{"cn": ..., "fraction": udział 0–1}`; w jednej liście wszystkie części mają ten sam rodzaj wagi (`area` albo `fraction`).

options.name: cn_values
options.description: CN values of the watershed parts (1-100); parallel to `areas` or `fractions`.

pl.description: Wartości CN części zlewni (1–100); równolegle do `areas` albo `fractions`.

options.name: areas
options.description: Areas of the parts (>= 0, any consistent unit); as many items as `cn_values`.

pl.description: Powierzchnie części (≥ 0, jednolita jednostka dowolna); tyle elementów, ile `cn_values`.

options.name: fractions
options.description: Shares of the parts in the watershed (0-1) summing to 1; as many items as `cn_values`.

pl.description: Udziały części w zlewni (0–1), sumujące się do 1; tyle elementów, ile `cn_values`.

rules: Use one weight kind per call; fractions must sum to 1.
Use one area unit for all parts.
Pass the fractional CN on without rounding.

pl.summary: Oblicz średnią ważoną CN zlewni złożonej z kilku pokryć lub gleb.
pl.description: Średnia ważona CN zlewni z części o znanym CN i powierzchni lub udziale: `parts`, albo równoległe `cn_values` z `areas` lub `fractions` (suma udziałów = 1). Użyj po `cn lookup` dla każdej części; wynik jest ułamkowy i nadaje się do `scs effective`.
rules: Użyj jednego rodzaju wag; udziały muszą sumować się do 1.
Użyj jednej jednostki powierzchni dla wszystkich części.
Przekaż dalej ułamkowe CN bez zaokrąglania.
